verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of dependency-tracking features (e.g., linked items, dependency columns, Gantt/timeline views) that would let a PM coordinate cross-team dependencies; nearly all monday-docs items focus on AI agents/MCP integration, unrelated to planning dependencies. One community comment (monday-comm-4) explicitly states 'Linking tickets to one another in Monday is really bad, data gets lost all the time,' which is negative anecdotal evidence but there's no vendor claim of dependency tracking to formally dispute. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation of dependency/linking features, timeline/Gantt views, or cross-team coordination workflows, and any positive hands-on evidence of this capability working.
